verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah . . . from the LORD saying
verses.literalPt: A PALAVRA que da parte do SENHOR, veio a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: עֲמֹ֗ד בְּשַׁ֙עַר֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה כָּל־ יְהוּדָה֙ הַבָּאִים֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·mōḏ bə·ša·‘ar bêṯ Yah·weh wə·qā·rā·ṯā šām ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wə·’ā·mar·tā šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bā·’îm baš·šə·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD - and proclaim this . . . message Hear the word of the LORD all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD
verses.literalPt: Põe-te à porta da casa do SENHOR, e proclama ali esta palavra, e dize: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, todos de Judá, os que entrais por estas portas, para adorardes ao SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hê·ṭî·ḇū ḏar·ḵê·ḵem ū·ma·‘al·lê·ḵem wa·’ă·šak·kə·nāh ’eṯ·ḵem bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel Correct your ways and deeds and I will let you live in this place
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Melhorai os vossos caminhos e as vossas obras, e vos farei habitar neste lugar.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū lā·ḵem ’el- diḇ·rê haš·še·qer lê·mōr hê·ḵal Yah·weh hê·ḵal Yah·weh hê·ḵal Yah·weh hêm·māh
verses.literal: Do not trust in deceptive words saying This is the temple of the LORD the temple of the LORD the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não vos fieis em palavras falsas, dizendo: Templo do SENHOR, templo do SENHOR, templo do SENHOR é este.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ הֵיטֵיב֙ תֵּיטִ֔יבוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ מַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם אִם־ עָשׂ֤וֹ תַֽעֲשׂוּ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֥ין רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- hê·ṭêḇ tê·ṭî·ḇū ’eṯ- dar·ḵê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ma·‘al·lê·ḵem ’im- ‘ā·śōw ṯa·‘ă·śū miš·pāṭ bên ’îš ū·ḇên rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: For if you really correct . . . your ways and deeds if you act . . . justly . . . toward one . . . another
verses.literalPt: Mas, se deveras melhorardes os vossos caminhos e as vossas obras; se deveras praticardes o juízo entre um homem e o seu próximo;

verses.original: גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְאַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־ תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gêr yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh lō ṯa·‘ă·šō·qū wə·ḏām nā·qî ’al- tiš·pə·ḵū bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lō ṯê·lə·ḵū lə·ra‘ lā·ḵem
verses.literal: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow . . . other . . . gods to your own harm
verses.literalPt: Se não oprimirdes o estrangeiro, e o órfão, e a viúva, nem derramardes sangue inocente neste lugar, nem andardes após outros deuses para vosso próprio mal,

verses.original: וְשִׁכַּנְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šik·kan·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem lə·min- ‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: then I will let you live in this place in the land that I gave to your fathers forever . . . and ever
verses.literalPt: Eu vos farei habitar neste lugar, na terra que dei a vossos pais, desde os tempos antigos e para sempre.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’at·tem bō·ṭə·ḥîm lā·ḵem ‘al- diḇ·rê haš·šā·qer lə·ḇil·tî hō·w·‘îl
verses.literal: But look you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail
verses.literalPt: Eis que vós confiais em palavras falsas, que para nada vos aproveitam.

verses.original: הֲגָנֹ֤ב׀ רָצֹ֙חַ֙ וְֽנָאֹ֔ף וְהִשָּׁבֵ֥עַ לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר וְקַטֵּ֣ר לַבָּ֑עַל וְהָלֹ֗ךְ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḡā·nōḇ rā·ṣō·aḥ wə·nā·’ōp̄ wə·hiš·šā·ḇê·a‘ laš·še·qer wə·qaṭ·ṭêr lab·bā·‘al wə·hā·lōḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏa‘·tem
verses.literal: Will you steal and murder commit adultery and perjury . . . burn incense to Baal and follow . . . other gods that you have not known
verses.literalPt: Porventura furtareis, e matareis, e adulterareis, e jurareis falsamente, e queimareis incenso a Baal, e andareis após outros deuses que não conhecestes,

verses.original: וּבָאתֶ֞ם וַעֲמַדְתֶּ֣ם לְפָנַ֗י בַּבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֔יו וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם נִצַּ֑לְנוּ לְמַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṯem wa·‘ă·maḏ·tem lə·p̄ā·nay bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw wa·’ă·mar·tem niṣ·ṣal·nū lə·ma·‘an ‘ă·śō·wṯ ’êṯ kāl- hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: and then come and stand before Me in this house which bears My Name . . . and say We are delivered so we can continue with all these abominations
verses.literalPt: E então vireis, e vos poreis diante de mim nesta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, e direis: Fomos libertados para fazermos todas estas abominações?

verses.original: הַמְעָרַ֣ת פָּרִצִ֗ים הָיָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָֽא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם גַּ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה רָאִ֖יתִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ham·‘ā·raṯ pā·ri·ṣîm hā·yāh hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer- niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem gam ’ā·nō·ḵî hin·nêh rā·’î·ṯî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Has this house which bears My Name become a den of robbers in your sight Yes I too have seen it declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: É pois esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, uma caverna de salteadores aos vossos olhos? Eis que eu, eu mesmo, vi isto, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לְכוּ־ נָ֗א אֶל־ מְקוֹמִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשִׁיל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכַּ֧נְתִּֽי שְׁמִ֛י שָׁ֖ם בָּרִֽאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּרְאוּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי ל֔וֹ מִפְּנֵ֕י רָעַ֖ת עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî lə·ḵū- nā ’el- mə·qō·w·mî ’ă·šer bə·šî·lōw ’ă·šer šik·kan·tî šə·mî šām bā·ri·šō·w·nāh ū·rə·’ū ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lōw mip·pə·nê rā·‘aṯ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name . . . and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas ide agora ao meu lugar, que estava em Siló, onde, ao princípio, fiz habitar o meu nome, e vede o que lhe fiz, por causa da maldade do meu povo Israel.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה יַ֧עַן עֲשׂוֹתְכֶ֛ם אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּֽעֲשִׂ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וָאֲדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם וְדַבֵּר֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם וָאֶקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲנִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ya·‘an ‘ă·śō·wṯ·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma·‘ă·śîm hā·’êl·leh nə·’um- Yah·weh wā·’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·ḵem haš·kêm wə·ḏab·bêr wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem wā·’eq·rā ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō ‘ă·nî·ṯem
verses.literal: And now because you have done all these things declares the LORD and because I have spoken to you again and again . . . but you would not listen and I have called to you but you would not answer
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, porquanto fazeis todas estas obras, diz o SENHOR, e eu vos falei, madrugando, e falando, e não ouvistes, e chamei-vos, e não respondestes,

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי לַבַּ֣יִת׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים בּ֔וֹ וְלַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְשִׁלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî lab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer ’at·tem bō·ṭə·ḥîm bōw wə·lam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·ši·lōw
verses.literal: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name . . . the house in which you trust the place that I gave to you and your fathers
verses.literalPt: Farei também a esta casa, que se chama pelo meu nome, na qual confiais, e a este lugar, que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais, como fiz a Siló.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלַ֙כְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·laḵ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·‘al pā·nāy ka·’ă·šer hiš·laḵ·tî ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ’êṯ kāl- ze·ra‘ ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: And I will cast you out of My presence just as I have cast out all your brothers all the descendants of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: E lançar-vos-ei de diante de minha face, como lancei a todos os vossos irmãos, a toda a geração de Efraim.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אַל־ תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל׀ בְּעַד־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְאַל־ תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛ם רִנָּ֥ה וּתְפִלָּ֖ה וְאַל־ תִּפְגַּע־ בִּ֑י כִּי־ אֵינֶ֥נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’al- tiṯ·pal·lêl bə·‘aḏ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·’al- tiś·śā ḇa·‘ă·ḏām rin·nāh ū·ṯə·p̄il·lāh wə·’al- tip̄·ga‘- bî kî- ’ê·nen·nî šō·mê·a‘ ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: As for you do not pray for these people do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf and do not beg Me for I will not listen to you
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, não ores por este povo, nem levantes por ele clamor ou oração, nem me supliques, porque eu não te ouvirei.

verses.original: הַֽאֵינְךָ֣ רֹאֶ֔ה מָ֛ה הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ê·nə·ḵā rō·’eh māh hêm·māh ‘ō·śîm bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Porventura não vês tu o que andam fazendo nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém?

verses.original: הַבָּנִ֞ים מְלַקְּטִ֣ים עֵצִ֗ים וְהָֽאָבוֹת֙ מְבַעֲרִ֣ים אֶת־ הָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים לָשׁ֣וֹת בָּצֵ֑ק לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת כַּוָּנִ֜ים לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְהַסֵּ֤ךְ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·nîm mə·laq·qə·ṭîm ‘ê·ṣîm wə·hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ mə·ḇa·‘ă·rîm ’eṯ- hā·’êš wə·han·nā·šîm lā·šō·wṯ bā·ṣêq la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kaw·wā·nîm lim·le·ḵeṯ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·has·sêḵ nə·sā·ḵîm lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·ma·‘an haḵ·‘i·sê·nî
verses.literal: The sons gather wood the fathers light the fire and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger
verses.literalPt: Os filhos apanham a lenha, e os pais acendem o fogo, e as mulheres preparam a massa, para fazerem bolos à rainha dos céus, e oferecem libações a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira.

verses.original: הַאֹתִ֛י הֵ֥ם מַכְעִסִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֹתָ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן בֹּ֥שֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·’ō·ṯî hêm maḵ·‘i·sîm nə·’um- Yah·weh hă·lō·w ’ō·ṯām lə·ma·‘an bō·šeṯ pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: But am I the One they are provoking declares the LORD Is it not themselves they spite to their own shame . . .
verses.literalPt: Acaso é a mim que eles provocam à ira? diz o SENHOR, e não a si mesmos, para confusão dos seus rostos?

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אַפִּ֤י וַֽחֲמָתִי֙ נִתֶּ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַל־ עֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְעַל־ פְּרִ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh ’ap·pî wa·ḥă·mā·ṯî nit·te·ḵeṯ ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh ‘al- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·‘al- hab·bə·hê·māh wə·‘al- ‘êṣ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·‘al- pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ū·ḇā·‘ă·rāh wə·lō ṯiḵ·beh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Behold My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place on man and beast on the trees of the field . . . and the produce of the land and it will burn and not be extinguished
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que a minha ira e o meu furor se derramarão sobre este lugar, sobre os homens e sobre os animais, e sobre as árvores do campo, e sobre os frutos da terra; e acender-se-á, e não se apagará.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹלוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל־ זִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם וְאִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem sə·p̄ū ‘al- ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem wə·’iḵ·lū ḇā·śār
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Add your burnt offerings . . . to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ajuntai os vossos holocaustos aos vossos sacrifícios, e comei carne.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ דִבַּ֤רְתִּי אֶת־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔ים בְּי֛וֹם הוֹצִיא אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י עוֹלָ֖ה וָזָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ḏib·bar·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·lō ṣiw·wî·ṯîm bə·yō·wm hō·ṣī ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- diḇ·rê ‘ō·w·lāh wā·zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: For when . . . I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt I did not merely command them about . . . burnt offerings and sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Porque nunca falei a vossos pais, no dia em que os tirei da terra do Egito, nem lhes ordenei coisa alguma acerca de holocaustos ou sacrifícios.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִֽם־ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹתָ֤ם לֵאמֹר֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָכֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām lê·mōr šim·‘ū ḇə·qō·w·lî wə·hā·yî·ṯî lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm wə·’at·tem tih·yū- lî lə·‘ām wa·hă·laḵ·tem bə·ḵāl had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem lə·ma·‘an yî·ṭaḇ lā·ḵem
verses.literal: but . . . - this is what I commanded them - Obey Me . . . and I will be your God and you will be My people You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you so that it may go well with you
verses.literalPt: Mas isto lhes ordenei, dizendo: Dai ouvidos à minha voz, e eu serei o vosso Deus, e vós sereis o meu povo; e andai em todo o caminho que eu vos mandar, para que vos vá bem.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּמֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּשְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣ם הָרָ֑ע וַיִּהְי֥וּ לְאָח֖וֹר וְלֹ֥א לְפָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū wə·lō- hiṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nām way·yê·lə·ḵū bə·mō·‘ê·ṣō·wṯ biš·ri·rūṯ lib·bām hā·rā‘ way·yih·yū lə·’ā·ḥō·wr wə·lō lə·p̄ā·nîm
verses.literal: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts They went backward and not forward
verses.literalPt: Mas não ouviram, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas andaram nos seus próprios conselhos, no propósito do seu coração malvado; e andaram para trás, e não para diante.

verses.original: לְמִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים י֖וֹם הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·’eš·laḥ ’ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay han·nə·ḇî·’îm yō·wm haš·kêm wə·šā·lō·aḥ
verses.literal: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day I have sent you all My servants the prophets . . . again and again . . .
verses.literalPt: Desde o dia em que vossos pais saíram da terra do Egito, até hoje, enviei-vos todos os meus servos, os profetas, todos os dias madrugando e enviando-os.

verses.original: וְל֤וֹא שָׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ עָרְפָּ֔ם הֵרֵ֖עוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō·w šā·mə·‘ū ’ê·lay wə·lō hiṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nām way·yaq·šū ’eṯ- ‘ā·rə·pām hê·rê·‘ū mê·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers
verses.literalPt: Mas não me deram ouvidos, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas endureceram a sua cerviz, e fizeram pior do que seus pais.

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֽוּכָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·lō yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·qā·rā·ṯā ’ă·lê·hem wə·lō ya·‘ă·nū·ḵāh
verses.literal: When you tell them all these things they will not listen to you When you call to them they will not answer
verses.literalPt: Dir-lhes-ás, pois, todas estas palavras, mas não te darão ouvidos; chamá-los-ás, mas não te responderão.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֶ֤ה הַגּוֹי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֽוֹא־ שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א לָקְח֖וּ מוּסָ֑ר אָֽבְדָה֙ הָֽאֱמוּנָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מִפִּיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem zeh hag·gō·w ’ă·šer lō·w- šā·mə·‘ū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·lō lā·qə·ḥū mū·sār ’ā·ḇə·ḏāh hā·’ĕ·mū·nāh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh mip·pî·hem
verses.literal: Therefore you must say to them This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction Truth has perished it has disappeared from their lips
verses.literalPt: E lhes dirás: Esta é a nação que não deu ouvidos à voz do SENHOR seu Deus e não aceitou a correção; já pereceu a verdade, e foi cortada da sua boca.

verses.original: גָּזִּ֤י נִזְרֵךְ֙ וְֽהַשְׁלִ֔יכִי וּשְׂאִ֥י עַל־ שְׁפָיִ֖ם קִינָ֑ה כִּ֚י מָאַ֣ס יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּטֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־ דּ֥וֹר עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gāz·zî niz·rêḵ wə·haš·lî·ḵî ū·śə·’î ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yim qî·nāh kî mā·’as Yah·weh way·yiṭ·ṭōš ’eṯ- dō·wr ‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Cut off your hair and throw it away Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath
verses.literalPt: Corta o teu cabelo e lança-o de ti, e levanta um pranto sobre as alturas; porque já o SENHOR rejeitou e desamparou a geração do seu furor.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָ֥ה הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י נְאֻום־ יְהוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·śū ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nay nə·’u·wm- Yah·weh śā·mū šiq·qū·ṣê·hem bab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ā·lāw lə·ṭam·mə·’ōw
verses.literal: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight declares the LORD They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name . . . and so have defiled it
verses.literalPt: Porque os filhos de Judá fizeram o que era mau aos meus olhos, diz o SENHOR; puseram as suas abominações na casa que se chama pelo meu nome, para contaminá-la.

verses.original: וּבָנ֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת הַתֹּ֗פֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם לִשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צִוִּ֔יתִי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־ לִבִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nū bā·mō·wṯ hat·tō·p̄eṯ ’ă·šer bə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm liś·rōp̄ ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯê·hem bā·’êš ’ă·šer lō ṣiw·wî·ṯî wə·lō ‘ā·lə·ṯāh ‘al- lib·bî
verses.literal: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so they could burn their sons . . . . . . . . . and daughters in the fire something I never commanded nor did it even enter . . . My mind
verses.literalPt: E edificaram os altos de Tofete, que está no Vale do Filho de Hinom, para queimarem no fogo a seus filhos e a suas filhas, o que nunca ordenei, nem me subiu ao coração.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַתֹּ֙פֶת֙ וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם־ גֵּ֣יא הַהֲרֵגָ֑ה וְקָבְר֥וּ בְתֹ֖פֶת מֵאֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō- yê·’ā·mêr ‘ō·wḏ hat·tō·p̄eṯ wə·ḡê ḇen- hin·nōm kî ’im- gê ha·hă·rê·ḡāh wə·qā·ḇə·rū ḇə·ṯō·p̄eṯ mê·’ên mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: So behold the days are coming declares the LORD when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Ben-hinnom . . . . . . but . . . the Valley of Slaughter For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que não se chamará mais Tofete, nem Vale do Filho de Hinom, mas o Vale da Matança; e enterrarão em Tofete, por não haver outro lugar.

verses.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה נִבְלַ֨ת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh niḇ·laṯ hā·‘ām haz·zeh lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl lə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth and there will be no one to scare them away
verses.literalPt: E os cadáveres deste povo servirão de pasto às aves dos céus e aos animais da terra; e ninguém os espantará.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י׀ מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמֵֽחֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְחָרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî mê·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mê·ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim qō·wl śā·śō·wn wə·qō·wl śim·ḥāh qō·wl ḥā·ṯān wə·qō·wl kal·lāh kî lə·ḥā·rə·bāh tih·yeh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I will remove from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sounds of joy and gladness . . . and the voices of the bride and bridegroom for the land will become a wasteland
verses.literalPt: E farei cessar nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém, a voz de gozo, e a voz de alegria, a voz de esposo e a voz de esposa; porque a terra se tornará em desolação.
